description: Accessiboss visitor panel settings for one site. action get (default; the draft), versions (published versions, newest first), save_draft (config = the settings object; invalid values are replaced by defaults; confirm), publish (publishes the draft; visitors get it within about 5 minutes; confirm), rollback (version; publishes an older version again; confirm), kill_switch (on true/false; true removes the panel for visitors at once; confirm), preview_link (a signed link valid for one hour that shows the saved draft on the live site to whoever opens it; visitors keep the published settings).

action.description: get is default. save_draft, publish, rollback and kill_switch need confirm. preview_link returns a private one hour link to the draft on the live site.

config.description: save_draft: the panel settings object (see action get).

note.description: publish: short note for the version list.

on.description: kill_switch: true removes the panel for visitors at once.

site.description: Accessiboss site: id, public key or domain. Optional when the account has one site.

version.description: rollback: version number from action versions.

name: oma_accessiboss_config
title: Accessiboss panel settings
